\begin{frame}{Appendix M3 - Weeks 3-4: test, review, decide}
  \hypertarget{a-tests}{}\appendixhead{M3 - Controlled Tests}
  \begin{columns}[T,onlytextwidth]\column{0.48\textwidth}\smallcapslabel{Week 3 - small tests}\par\vspace{0.06cm}\begin{itemize}\setlength\itemsep{0.08cm}\fontsize{8}{9.5}\selectfont\item One featured food item\item One drink feature or bundle\item One welcome gesture\item Proactive menu/buffet/drink guidance\item Capture eligible orders, uptake, margin and feedback\end{itemize}\column{0.48\textwidth}\smallcapslabel{Week 4 - review and decide}\par\vspace{0.06cm}\begin{itemize}\setlength\itemsep{0.08cm}\fontsize{8}{9.5}\selectfont\item Review rolling 30d/90d and open cases\item Compare uptake, margin and staff burden\item Stop, adjust or scale each test\item Schedule next buffet feedback cycle\item Update menu/favourites only when evidence is ready\end{itemize}\end{columns}\vfill\backbutton{m-actions}{Back to Action Plan}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Appendix M4 - Competitor and market tasting assignment}
  \hypertarget{a-market-scan}{}\appendixhead{M4 - Market Scan}
  \begin{columns}[T,onlytextwidth]\column{0.48\textwidth}\smallcapslabel{Visit and observe}\par\vspace{0.06cm}\begin{itemize}\setlength\itemsep{0.07cm}\fontsize{7.8}{9.3}\selectfont\item Taste comparable dishes\item Observe food and drink presentation\item Identify famous/popular dishes as presented\item Compare menu structure and buffet offer\item Observe service, welcome and guidance\item Note pricing, offers and bundles\end{itemize}\column{0.48\textwidth}\smallcapslabel{Bring to weekly review}\par\vspace{0.06cm}\begin{itemize}\setlength\itemsep{0.07cm}\fontsize{7.8}{9.3}\selectfont\item Venue/date and assigned staff\item Comparable items and price notes\item Photos/notes where appropriate\item What appears transferable\item What should not be copied\item One test hypothesis with owner and metric\end{itemize}\end{columns}\vfill\colorbox{PaleTeal}{\parbox{0.965\linewidth}{\fontsize{7.5}{8.9}\selectfont Immediate: schedule and assign the first visit. Long term: repeat a light market scan monthly or quarterly and review findings with POS/review evidence.}}\par\vspace{0.07cm}\backbutton{m-actions}{Back to Action Plan}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Appendix M5 - Four workstreams and escalation}
  \hypertarget{a-workstreams}{}\appendixhead{M5 - Ownership}
  {\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2pt}\fontsize{6.6}{7.9}\selectfont\begin{tabular}{p{2.6cm}p{2.2cm}p{4.15cm}p{2.25cm}p{2.3cm}}\toprule\textbf{Workstream} & \textbf{Owner} & \textbf{Responsibilities / deliverables} & \textbf{Weekly KPIs} & \textbf{Escalation question}\\\midrule Reputation \& Data & Admin/marketing or manager & Reviews, responses, case log, dashboard, evidence tracking & Response, delay, open cases & Any case overdue or data missing?\\Guest Experience & Service lead & Welcome, menu guidance, waiting, communication, buffet service & Service negatives, waiting, feedback & Repeating shift or journey failure?\\Kitchen \& Buffet Quality & Kitchen lead & Food cases, dish quality, freshness, consistency, buffet checks & Food/Taste negatives, buffet sentiment & Same dish/process/holding issue?\\Menu, Bar \& Offers & Manager + assigned owner & POS analysis, menu hypotheses, favourites method, offers, drinks, media & Uptake, margin, complaints, mentions & Enough evidence to change or scale?\\\bottomrule\end{tabular}}\par\vspace{0.15cm}\colorbox{PaleGold}{\parbox{0.965\linewidth}{\fontsize{7.4}{8.8}\selectfont Delegate ownership, not accountability. The manager reviews progress, evidence, blockers and next dates every week.}}\par\vspace{0.07cm}\backbutton{m-delegation}{Back to Delegation}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Appendix M6 - Low-score response and closure process}
  \hypertarget{a-response-process}{}\appendixhead{M6 - Response Process}
  \begin{columns}[T,onlytextwidth]\column{0.52\textwidth}\begin{enumerate}\setlength\itemsep{0.08cm}\fontsize{8}{9.5}\selectfont\item Log the review and anonymous case ID.\item Assign workstream owner and 48-hour response target.\item Acknowledge the experience without arguing.\item Reference the specific issue accurately.\item Run the internal operational check.\item Record public-response date and internal action.\item Close only when the check/action is documented.\end{enumerate}\column{0.42\textwidth}\colorbox{PaleRed}{\parbox{0.90\linewidth}{\fontsize{7.8}{9.3}\selectfont\bfseries Do not:\par copy generic replies\par reveal personal information\par promise unverified fixes\par debate publicly\par mark closed without evidence}}\par\vspace{0.16cm}{\fontsize{7.2}{8.6}\selectfont Day/time, shift and internal-resolution data are currently unavailable; capture them in the case log.}\end{columns}\vfill\backbutton{m-owner}{Back to Review Flow}\quad\backbutton{m-badcases}{Back to Operational Cases}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Appendix M7 - POS fields and decision matrix}
  \hypertarget{a-pos}{}\appendixhead{M7 - POS / Menu Decision Support}
  \begin{columns}[T,onlytextwidth]\column{0.46\textwidth}\sourceData\par\vspace{0.06cm}\begin{itemize}\setlength\itemsep{0.06cm}\fontsize{7.6}{9.1}\selectfont\item Item and category\item Orders and repeat orders\item Revenue and contribution margin\item Discounts, cancellations and returns\item Day/time and recent trend\item Offer/bundle participation\item Review-attention match\end{itemize}\column{0.50\textwidth}{\fontsize{7.3}{8.7}\selectfont\textbf{High order / high attention:} protect and highlight.\par\vspace{0.09cm}\textbf{High order / low attention:} sells but may not be memorable; improve storytelling.\par\vspace{0.09cm}\textbf{Low order / high attention:} niche or polarizing; investigate.\par\vspace{0.09cm}\textbf{Low order / low attention:} candidate for simplification only after margin and operational check.}\end{columns}\vfill\backbutton{m-menu}{Back to Menu \& Ordering}
